# Pull Request Review Instructions

When reviewing pull requests in this repository, please follow these guidelines to ensure story quality, consistency, and alignment with the project's vision.

## Character Consistency

- Use the `./github/agents/CharactersAssistant/` agent to cross-check character traits, backgrounds, and arcs.
- When considering changes to character profiles (in the `/characters` or `/Minor Characters` directory), ensure that any modifications align with established traits, backgrounds, and arcs.
- Flag any inconsistencies or contradictions in character behavior or history.

## Story Consistency

- Use the `./github/agents/StoryAssistant/` agent to verify plot points, timelines, and thematic elements when reviewing changes in the `/Stories` and `/Plot Arcs` directories.
- If there are character actions or developments that expand on that character's established arc or storyline, suggest that those changes be reflected in the character's profile.
